title: thelypteris supranitens
intro: Thelypteris supranitens, commonly known as the royal fern, is a plant species in the family Thelypteridaceae. It is a type of vascular plant that belongs to the division Pteridophyta, characterized by its fronds with multiple pinnate segments. The royal fern has been found to possess various health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may help in reducing the risk of certain diseases. The bioactive constituents present in the plant, such as flavonoids and phenolic acids, are responsible for its therapeutic actions, including its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant effects.
